title: SciReC：多模态多轮关系推理的诊断评估与自适应交互
summary: SciReC是一个模型自适应的多模态学术对话基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在类比、结构、因果等关系推理任务上的表现。提出基于缺陷的诊断框架DMRA，量化视觉理解、知识、记忆等成分的贡献，定位失败原因。结果显示Claude 4.6最佳（73%），开源模型在空间关系上最弱，专有模型在层级和顺序关系上较弱，关系推理是主要错误来源。
summary_en: SciReC is a model-adaptive multimodal academic dialog benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on relational reasoning tasks (analogical, structural, causal). It introduces DMRA, a deficit-based diagnostic framework to quantify contributions of visual understanding, knowledge, memory. Claude 4.6 achieves best (73%), open-source models struggle with spatial relations, proprietary with hierarchical/sequential; relational reasoning is the primary error source.
